description: Balades fluviales en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Loire-Atlantique Développement. List of boat rental companies (boats, canoes, boats) and river tourism companies in the Loire-Atlantique. This dataset will be updated in early 2013. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique Développement. The portal shows the English title as "River rides in Loire-Atlantique" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Loire-Atlantique Développement. Its keywords include equipement-de-loisir, activite-de-plein-air, loisir. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XLS, XML, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2015-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
